schema.text: Overall, how satisfied are you with your current primary mode of transport?
schema.help: Your primary mode is the way you travel most often.

en.#Overall, how satisfied are you with you: Overall, how satisfied are you with your current primary mode of transport?
en.#Your primary mode is the way you travel: Your primary mode is the way you travel most often.

it.#Overall, how satisfied are you with you: Nel complesso, quanto sei soddisfatto/a della tua attuale modalità di trasporto principale?
it.#Your primary mode is the way you travel: La tua modalità principale è il modo in cui ti sposti più spesso.

fr.#Overall, how satisfied are you with you: Dans l’ensemble, êtes-vous satisfait(e) de votre principal mode de transport actuel ?
fr.#Your primary mode is the way you travel: Votre mode principal est la façon dont vous vous déplacez le plus souvent.

de.#Overall, how satisfied are you with you: Wie zufrieden sind Sie insgesamt mit Ihrem derzeit wichtigsten Verkehrsmittel?
de.#Your primary mode is the way you travel: Ihr wichtigstes Verkehrsmittel ist das, mit dem Sie am häufigsten unterwegs sind.

tr.#Overall, how satisfied are you with you: Genel olarak, şu anda en sık kullandığınız ulaşım seçeneğinden ne kadar memnunsunuz?
tr.#Your primary mode is the way you travel: Başlıca ulaşım şekliniz, en sık yolculuk ettiğiniz yoldur.
tr.#Neither satisfied nor dissatisfied: Ne memnunum ne de memnun değilim

fa.#Overall, how satisfied are you with you: در مجموع، از روش اصلی رفت‌وآمد فعلی خود چقدر راضی هستید؟
fa.#Your primary mode is the way you travel: شیوهٔ اصلی رفت‌وآمد شما همانی است که بیشتر از همه از آن استفاده می‌کنید.

hu.#Overall, how satisfied are you with you: Összességében mennyire elégedett a jelenleg leggyakrabban használt közlekedési módjával?
hu.#Your primary mode is the way you travel: A fő közlekedési módja az, amellyel a leggyakrabban utazik.

ar.#Overall, how satisfied are you with you: بشكل عام، ما مدى رضاك عن وسيلة التنقل الرئيسية التي تستخدمها حاليًا؟
ar.#Your primary mode is the way you travel: وسيلتك الرئيسية هي الطريقة التي تتنقل بها أكثر من غيرها.
